objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document through creation, release, distribution, revision, archiving, and reactivation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Includes type abbreviation, consecutive number, and title by default.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle state such as editing, released, or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a released document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification and level of a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document naming.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating a new document object for a document type.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Specific version of a document with documented release signatures and lifecycle status.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and released with it.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle state following the release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing a document without initially affecting document content or version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Editing or completion state of the proposal.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Workflow-supported request created to check and extend document validity.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Workflow-supported request for declaring a released document out of force.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access, and business administration.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Document-specific list of user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation that a recipient has taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature recorded for workflow participants during release or translation approval.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type or template.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document properties and metadata.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations and workflow participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the three-step approval process after document creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Assigned reviewer completes the review task positively.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task positively.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reviewer or releaser rejects a workflow task, canceling subsequent workflow participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or version-triggering changes occur.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a released or validated document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals and stop displaying completed proposals in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a validity extension request 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, and update the valid until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request to invalidate a released document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document and its attachments invalid, archive them, revoke rights except archive group, and set the last approved version out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation and create a new document version with retained metadata and restored authorizations.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons for distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail upon release for maintained recipients.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the current document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release a translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

o2o.description: A document has a selected document type.
One or more templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created based on a selected template.
A document is managed in versions.
A document can have controlled attachments.
A document can have additional information.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
An override request is created for a selected document.
A reactivation request selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Users can be assigned to user groups.
Users can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator, creator, or initiator.
User groups can be assigned authorizations and reader access for documents.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
Acknowledgement concerns the current version of a document.
A recipient confirms acknowledgement.
Document visibility can be specified per client.

o2e.description: The created object is a document.
A corresponding document type is selected during document creation.
A document template can be selected during document creation.
A creator creates the document.
Metadata is maintained for the document.
The user can maintain document metadata.
Content is edited for the document.
The user edits document content.
Saved document content is converted to PDF.
Authorizations are assigned on the document.
Persons can be assigned personal authorizations.
User groups can be assigned group authorizations.
Additional information is added to the document.
The added object is additional information.
The author decides which object type is added.
Additional information is released and published directly.
Additional information can be deleted directly.
A controlled attachment is added to a document.
The added object is an attachment.
The author decides which object type is added.
Archiving an attachment affects the associated main document version.
The attachment is marked for archiving and archived.
Release workflow is started for the document.
The author or a co-author starts the release process.
The creator step is performed for the document.
The registered author signs the creator step.
The task is completed with an electronic signature.
Review is completed for the document.
Assigned reviewers complete review tasks.
Review completion uses an electronic signature.
Release is completed for the document.
Assigned releasers complete release tasks.
Release completion uses an electronic signature.
The document workflow is canceled after rejection.
A reviewer or releaser rejects the task.
The released document is published.
Revision creates a new editing version.
A new document version is created in editing status.
The author creates a new version when revision is needed.
A change proposal is created for a document.
The created object is a change proposal.
Employees with author rights can create change proposals.
Scheduling a change proposal creates a new document version.
The change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
A new version is created for implementation.
The assigned change proposal is completed.
The author documents the editing of the proposal.
The request is linked to the document to be checked.
The system creates the validity extension request.
The document remains valid in its current version.
The request is deleted after declaring additional validity.
Releasers or release-process users carry out the check depending on process.
Attachments are also released and have the same validity as the main document.
An override request is created for the document.
The created object is an override request.
Users with write access can create the request.
The document is invalidated and archived.
Attachments are invalidated and archived with the document.
The request remains for documentation.
All rights except archive group access are revoked.
Archived documents are physically deleted after archive duration expires.
The corresponding document is selected for reactivation.
The created object is a reactivation request.
Only the Business Admin group may create reactivation requests.
The invalidated document is reactivated.
A new version is created during reactivation.
Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.
The initiator is the editor of the workflow step.
The distribution list is maintained.
Distribution is maintained for a document.
Persons can be assigned to distribution.
User groups can be assigned to distribution.
Acknowledgement is requested upon release of the document.
Recipients come from the distribution list for acknowledgement.
Recipients are requested to acknowledge.
Acknowledgement workflow task is created.
The acknowledgement is confirmed.
The recipient confirms acknowledgement.
Acknowledgement concerns the current version.
Released document content is translated.
A translator translates released content.
Translated language version is checked and released.
Assigned participants check and release the translation.
Translation approval is workflow-supported like release.
Visibility is specified for the document.
The document can be made visible or not visible in clients.
